description:
This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12.  This announcement constitutes the only solicitation.  Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued.  

 Solicitation number 1240LT27Q0015 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for GAOA BRF Roofing Project for the Bitterroot National Forest.   

 The work includes: 

 
	 Removal and disposal of existing roofing system and associated fasteners, underlayment, applicable trim, flashing, and drip edge. 
	 Inspection of roof decking and identification of damaged decking 
	 Installation of underlayment, moisture barriers, flashing, and trim components. 
	 Installation of new roofing meeting performance criteria outlines in this SOW, 
	 Installation of replacement ridge caps, closures, and sealants, 
	 Ensuring proper weatherproofing around penetrations, vents, and mechanical equipment 
	 Final cleanup and disposal of all construction debris. 
 

 The roofing systems to be replaced are as follows: 

 Stevensville Garage Shop: Asphalt Shingles (existing 3-Tab shingles, new architectural shingles) 

 WF Bunkhouse: Metal Roofing (existing “delta rib”, new standing seam), includes cupola 

 WF Laundry Facility: Metal Roofing (existing “delta rib”, new standing seam) 

 Optional Item – Darby Visitor Center: Cedar shingles (Historic Building) 

 This acquisition  is set-aside for small business concerns.  The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 238160 Roofing Contractors.  The small business size standard is $19 million.  This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside.  All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency.
